sloka: हरिपादविनिर्भग्नो निषसाद स पर्वतः।न शशाक तदा ऽ ऽत्मानं सोढुं भृशनिपीडितः ।। ६.७४.३७ ।।
transliteration: haripādavinirbhagno niṣasāda sa parvataḥ।na śaśāka tadā ' 'tmānaṁ soḍhuṁ bhṛśanipīḍitaḥ ।। 6.74.37 ।।

translations.english: Trodden by the feet of Hanuman that mountain pressed forcibly by himself could not bear his strength.
